title: Sentinelle d'airain
design: A squat broad ancient Greek bronze automaton animated by a dead spirit. A small hollow Corinthian helmet recessed into huge shoulders, two tiny cold turquoise eye slits. Thick ivory stone torso framed by weathered bronze rib-like armor, broad solid legs, large articulated feet. One enormous round bronze shield on its LEFT arm, slightly turned aside so the torso and both legs remain readable; the shield has one bold diagonal crack with a very subtle turquoise interior. One short heavy spear held upright in its RIGHT hand, fully inside the image, clearly separated from its body. Stable grounded vigilant stance. Three major landmarks: recessed helmet, huge cracked disk shield, thick stone feet. No human face, no cape, no skeletal thin legs, no extra weapons. The result must feel like a threatening animated bronze guardian and not a living human soldier.
animation_note: Bouclier gauche et lance droite a conserver sans miroir; attaque courte, garde et marche lourde.
visual_review_note: Silhouette trapue et bouclier tres lisibles; lance tenue en diagonale. Verrouiller le cote des accessoires et harmoniser la plongee avant les quatre directions.
approval_context: 2026-09-08: Les 4 propositions sont vraiment bien, fais en des personnages complets

title: Rejeton de braise
design: A small hunched ash-grey underworld imp with a compact pear-shaped body, surprisingly long thick forearms, oversized clawed hands, short bent legs and two broad clearly planted three-toed feet. A narrow mischievous menacing face with a broad brow, exactly two short backward-pointing ivory horns. A warm muted ember-orange throat pouch and eyes, clean contained color with no glow halo. A torn terracotta ancient Greek waistcloth with one simple bronze clasp, otherwise exposed charcoal skin. Both hands visibly empty and separate from the body, slightly cupped as if about to spit or throw a coal later. Alert wary idle stance. Three major landmarks: oversized hands, two short horns, orange throat pouch. No tail, no wings, no flames, no smoke, no projectile, no huge teeth, no armor clutter. Clever hostile little monster, not a cute mascot.
animation_note: Attaque crache-braise avec VFX separe; grosses mains et gorge orange constantes.
visual_review_note: Anatomie bipede coherente, mains et gorge orange distinctives. Vue plus laterale que la sentinelle; harmoniser la camera avant les spritesheets.
approval_context: 2026-09-08: Les 4 propositions sont vraiment bien, fais en des personnages complets

title: Molosse du Styx
design: A single-headed lean supernatural hound of the Greek underworld, long low athletic quadruped silhouette, charcoal blue hide, broad angular ivory jaw plates and strong ivory brow ridge, muted teal eyes. Exactly three large backward-swept triangular ivory spines along its upper back. One plain thick ancient bronze collar without chains. Four robust clearly constructed canine legs and paws, legs naturally offset for readability, chest low in an alert stalking idle pose. One short sturdy tail curving upward and kept inside the silhouette envelope, fully visible. The head and muzzle turn slightly toward the viewer's right. Closed mouth with only two small visible canine teeth. Three major landmarks: massive ivory jaw, three dorsal spines, bronze collar. Restrained muscular anatomy under smooth hide, no shaggy fur, no extra heads, no extra legs, no wings, no saddle, no leash, no flame effects.
animation_note: Quadrupede: quatre appuis, morsure et bond; camera et masse constantes.
visual_review_note: Quatre pattes visibles et silhouette basse distincte. Prévoir un vrai cycle quadrupede et verifier les occlusions des pattes au changement de direction.
approval_context: 2026-09-08: Les 4 propositions sont vraiment bien, fais en des personnages complets

title: Lamie du Lethe
design: An ancient Greek underworld serpent oracle monster. A narrow upright feminine upper torso armored in bronze over opaque ivory ceremonial linen; a sculpted ivory mask-like face with muted teal eyes; three broad short fin-like jade head crests instead of hair. Exactly two arms, each clearly separated from the body. Below the waist one thick muscular desaturated jade serpent tail forms one compact readable S-shaped ground coil with its single tapering tip visible beside the body. No human legs. One simple hooked bronze staff held vertically away from the body in the RIGHT hand; LEFT hand open in a calm threatening spellcasting idle gesture with no spell effect. Three major landmarks: three broad head fins, narrow ivory masked torso, thick jade S-shaped tail. Elegant severe dangerous silhouette, no seductive posing, no exposed chest, no additional snakes, no snake hair, no floating fabric ribbons, no gems or tiny scale details. Closed mouth. Clearly a nonhuman serpent creature.
animation_note: Glissement sans root motion; une seule queue; sort, impact et aura dans des VFX distincts.
visual_review_note: Queue unique et silhouette en S distinctes. La sortie tient le baton de la main gauche, contrairement au prompt; fixer la lateralite du modele retenu avant toute animation. Crete plus elaboree que les trois pointes demandees.
approval_context: 2026-09-08: Les 4 propositions sont vraiment bien, fais en des personnages complets
